card.name: Lab testing and assay interference wording
card.fires_on: Mixed small words and pieces in drug-label text about lab tests, such as 'to' after 'due', 'as' after 'such', and the hyphen-treated in 'dithiothreitol-treated'. Mostly in sentences on test interference, screening or pooled analyses.

modes.label: Test interference sentences
modes.description: Linking words inside sentences about false-positive screens or assay interference.
modes.example: This is due<< to>> lack of specificity of the screening tests.

modes.label: Testing recommendations
modes.description: Words in lines about confirmatory or recommended tests.
modes.example: Confirmatory tests, such<< as>> gas chromatography/mass spectrometry

modes.label: Trial and citation punctuation
modes.description: Punctuation or word pieces in pooled-trial descriptions and references.
